text: You resign. They say: pay up, or it stays.
Handing originals over when you join? That's custody, with your consent.
But in twenty twelve, the Madras High Court said an employer can't hold them like a ransom.
Money owed? The employer can sue. The court told police to register a breach of trust case.
So get a signed receipt, ask for them back in writing, and keep every reply.
